**Academic Engine or Feature Description**
A clear description of the new examination cutoff model or academic calculation requested.

**Official Guidelines & Authority References**
Provide links or citations to the governing admission authority (e.g. DOTE TNEA, NTA, JoSAA) for cutoff rule verification.

**Mathematical Formula or Logic**
Detail the weighting, normalization, or eligibility criteria to be implemented.
